notes: Both paper titles verified. The neutral description and page locators do not identify which of several outcome tests belongs to this audit_id. No assignment by input order. The effect-size calculator URL for ID 57 does not identify a primary test and was not used to convert a statistic. Authors report an overall replication failure; this narrative verdict does not resolve the target-test ambiguity. Locator-enriched revisit: Appendix D uniquely identifies the replication humility-score condition comparison; extracted its printed t and p. Exact analytic n was not printed and was not derived from degrees of freedom. The Appendix D caption describes dividing log-transformed strength scores by log-transformed weakness scores, whereas Results describes log-transforming the strengths/weaknesses ratio; this operationalization discrepancy is retained. The original page locator remains p. 263 without an additional test locator, so the original side is preserved unchanged under the revisit restriction. The previously completed author verdict is preserved.
